concepts.gloss_en: The imaginative faculty (koach ha-medameh), identified in Torah 54 as an evil/melancholy spirit opposing the spirit of prophecy

reason_for_human: Both occurrences come from the same paragraph (54_6_9) and both surface forms trace to the identical vocalized word הַמְדַמֶּה (the imaginative faculty) — the 'מדמה' member is just the article-stripped rendering of the same word, not a homograph. Definite article is consistent throughout (archetypal faculty), so this is a single concept.
